name: creatify-ad-agent
description: Create and revise video ads with Creatify's Ad Agent.

interface.longDescription: Create video ads from a product brief and reference media. Review generated footage, adjust shots, captions, music and calls to action, then export a finished take through Creatify. A Creatify account and available credits are required for generation and shipping.
defaultPrompt: Make a 15-second video ad for my product
Create a video ad from these reference clips
Resume my latest Creatify Ad Agent project

negative.prompt: Write five headlines for my coffee ad. I only need text, not a video.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer with text only; do not start a video project or call Ad Agent tools.

negative.prompt: How do I add captions in CapCut?
negative.expected_behavior: Give general CapCut instructions; do not invoke the Creatify Ad Agent.

negative.prompt: Analyze my Meta ad campaign's CTR and ROAS.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that campaign analytics are outside this plugin's video creation workflow; do not invoke its tools.
